'''Tobias James Smith''', known by his online alias '''Tubbo''', is a British streamer and [[YouTube]]r known for collaborating with other content creators in ''[[Minecraft]]''. He is most known for his participation on the {{w|Dream SMP}}.

== Background ==
Smith registered his main channel on YouTube in 2018. His videos mainly consist of ''Minecraft'' multiplayer gameplay, especially on servers like Hypixel.

== In the ''Minecraft'' Franchise ==
Tubbo was a guest in the September 2025 Minecraft Live. He was part of the Deep Dig After-Show together with Shubble and Mogswamp.<ref>[https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/mclive_fall2025_recap Minecraft LIVE September 2025: The Recap]</ref>

He and [[Jojosolos]] hosted [[Dungeons II:The Last Stand]] in collaboration with [[Mojang Studios]] and Timbers Studio.
